title: Alliant Energy Corporation Announces First Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) has scheduled its first quarter earnings release for Thursday, April 30 th , after market close. A conference call to review the first quarter results is scheduled for Friday, May 1 st at 9 a.m. CT. Alliant Energy will webcast the event live at www.alliantenergy.com/investors . The call is open to the public and will be hosted by Lisa Barton, President and CEO; and Robert Durian, Executive Vice President and CFO. Individuals who would like to participate in the conference call can do so by dialing (800) 715-9871 (Toll Free – North America) or (646) 307-1963 (International). The conference ID is 9124041. An archive of the webcast will be available on the company’s website at www.alliantenergy.com/investors . Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) provides regulated energy service to approximately 1,010,000 electric and 435,000 natural gas customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.
